coaching_note: Move the agenda question ('what are your biggest concerns?') to the very start of the call—before you gather contact info—and then probe at least two layers deep on each concern raised; also deliver all five Save Your Ass lines (commit to rate, estimate-is-a-window, beats-it-pay-less, self-prep tip, does-that-feel-fair + silence) and close with an explicit rate-lock + booking ask.
